messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] prod /v1/generate — p99 18.4s, surge in 5xx/timeouts detected at ~03:12 UTC. Deployed model-server v1.4.2 at 03:09. Pager: @rohan
rohan: oncall here, acking. pulling logs now, setting priority=P1.
eli: seeing a lot of connect timeouts to inference-pool pods, gateway returning 502/504. KV cache warmup misses jumped, request queues growing.
jamie: can someone confirm if the 03:09 deploy changed batching/keepalive defaults? I pushed a kernel flag tweak yesterday.
eli: deploy did include batching config change and grpc pool size -> 10.
sophia: CS reported customers seeing errors. @customer-success-lina can you quantify impact?
customer-success-lina: yes — around 12 customers hit increased failures, roughly 50–200 failed requests per customer since 03:12. Opening priority outreach. :frowning:
rohan: mitigation plan: 1) scale down concurrency at edge, 2) flip canary off, 3) rollback model-server to v1.4.1 if quick check fails. Proceeding to rollback unless objections.
infra-bot: rollback request submitted: target service=model-server, from v1.4.2 -> v1.4.1. initiating. ETA ~90s.
jamie: quick shield: lowering gateway timeout for /v1/generate 30s->20s to avoid long tail blocking. will revert after stabilization.
eli: digging deeper: kernel traces show queued worker threads stuck on accept, TCP keepalive shows RSTs from a subset of worker nodes (maybe nat/egress).
rohan: staging/health checks OK but prod traces show request queue depth spike. rolling back now.
infra-bot: rollback successful at 03:16 UTC. traffic shifted back to v1.4.1.
rohan: telemetry update: p99 fell from 18.4s -> 1.2s within ~40s post-rollback. 5xx rate returning to baseline.
customer-success-lina: customer outreach underway — compiling impacted accounts and SLA exposure report. will send escalation list in #customer-notify.
sophia: opening incident ticket and scheduling postmortem. action items: tighten deploy gating for batching/kernel flags, add immediate canary p99 trigger, improve KV cache warmup visibility.
jamie: note: we expected auto-fallback on p99>5s but policy didn't trigger for this canary — investigating why the fallback hook failed.
rohan: handing off to SRE for deep-dive and postmortem. tagging @oncall-sre. summary saved to incident tracker.
oncall-sre: ack'd, taking lead on follow-up and timeline. will coordinate with infra and dev teams for root cause. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: incident marked mitigated/closed — rollback restored service. Follow-up: postmortem scheduled for tomorrow 10:00 UTC.
